title: Pokémon Concierge
native: ポケモンコンシェルジュ
synopsis:
Pack your bags—an all-new Pokémon paradise awaits!

Introducing Pokémon Concierge, a new collaboration between Pokémon and Netflix featuring stop-motion animation by dwarf studio. Set in a resort on a tropical island resort for Pokémon, rookie concierge Haru and her partner Psyduck interact with trainers and Pokémon guests in this heartwarming story of growth.

(Source: Official Pokémon YouTube video description, Netflix Anime, edited) 

Note: Announced on Pokémon Day 2023.

episodes.title: I'm Haru, the New Concierge!
episodes.synopsis:
For her first day as a concierge at the Pokémon Resort, all Haru has to do is enjoy herself on the island as if she were a guest herself!

(Source: Netflix)

episodes.title: What's on Your Mind, Psyduck?
episodes.synopsis:
Psyduck suffers from chronic headaches that erupt into disruptive psychic powers. Can Haru come up with a way to help?

(Source: Netflix)

episodes.title: I Hope I Can Evolve Too...
episodes.synopsis:
When a Magikarp who can't swim well loses his floatie to a passing Wingull, Haru and Psyduck fly after it on a Dragonite to try and get it back.

(Source: Netflix)

episodes.title: Welcome to Pokémon Resort!
episodes.synopsis:
Haru meets a shy little Pikachu whose trainer really wants him to be more outgoing. But here at Pokémon Resort, everyone is encouraged to be themselves. 

(Source: Netflix)
